uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: After using a move: increases movement speed by 50% for 2s (decaying by 5% every 0.25s). Increases movement speed by 10% while near an ally Latios. When not in combat, this Ability can be used to fly to an allied Latios. This Ability goes on cooldown for 90s after it's triggered for both Latios and Latias. While channeling this ability the user can move around, once the 2s channel is completed the user becomes unstoppable and flies to where Latios was when this ability was activated. If Latios is at the home base, the cooldown of Levitate goes down twice as fast for Latias.
Shoots a psychic projectile at an opposing Pokémon, damaging them. Latias has no boosted attack.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
Releases a weak telekinetic force in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s.

Releases a mist-like flurry of down in the designated direction. When used again or after 0.9s pass: the flurry of down bursts, creating a zone of mist in the area of effect dealing damage up to 2 more times. This move then goes on cooldown. The projectile and area of effect damages opposing Pokémon in it, decreases their movement speed by 40% for 2s, and marks them for 2s. Marked opposing Pokémon deal 25% decreased damage. If either Latias or Latios deals damage to marked opposing Pokémon: increases the duration of the mark by 1s. This duration extension can be continued indefinitely.

Rallies the designated ally Pokémon, granting a shield for 3s and extra damage for the next hit up to 3s: if the user targeted themself, the user will gain the shield and the extra damage. If an ally was targeted, the ally will gain the shield and the extra damage, while the user only gains the shield. The move can the be recasted within 3s, the recast must target an ally other than the user. When used, the ally will gain the shield and the extra damage, while the user will only gain the extra damage. If the designated ally is Latios, then Latios will additionally gain 20% movement speed for 2s. When this move is recast; Latias will fly towards the designated ally. This move's cooldown begins once the recast is used or expires. The damage increase is based on the rallied Pokémon's level.
Increased the strength of the shield.
Shoots star-shaped rays in a large area in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect.

After learning this move: Latias gains 2 Eon power for knocking out a wild Pokémon; or 2 Eon power per Pokémon from the opposing team hit by this move. When this move is used: Latias generates a beam in the designated direction, sweeping in a cone shape, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and restoring the user's HP once. While firing the beam, Latias moves 60% slower. This move gains 2 telekinetic projectiles at 25 and 100 Eon power, and gains 1 projectile at 50 and 75 Eon power for a total of 6 projectiles. Subsequent projectiles hitting the same target deal 15% less damage; further decreasing with each projectile to a maximum of 75% less damage. For every 1 Eon power accumulated beyond 100; the projectile damage increases by 0.5% (Eon power caps at 1099).
The beam now slows opposing Pokémon by 30% for 2s

After learning this move: Latias gains 2 Eon power for knocking out a wild Pokémon; or 3 Eon power per Pokémon from the opposing team hit by this move. When this move is used: Latias exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit, slowing them by 30% for 3s and decreasing their Sp. Def by 30% for 3s. This move gains increased range at 31 and 61 Eon Power. For every 1 Eon power accumulated beyond 60; the damage increases by 0.5% (Eon power caps at 1059).
The slow is increased to 40% for 3s

Aims at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team and charges power for 1.8s before releasing a pulse, damaging all opposing Pokémon hit. Resets move cooldowns immediately after releasing the pulse, and increases cooldown reduction by 20% for 9.5s. If Latios is also aiming its Unite Move at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, the pulses stack and explode, dealing damage around the target as well. If Mist Blast hits last then the explosion uses Latias' stats.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
